dedupe_keys.name: a new landslide investigation and simulation archive through downscaled landslide experiments

description: A new Landslide Investigation and Simulation Archive through downscaled landslide experiments is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Laura Longoni et al. Downscaled landslide experiments are an effective approach to studying complex interactions between landslide triggering factors. Working at a small scale allows seeing and measuring phenomena that cannot be quantified at a real scale with the same level of accuracy. In addition, small scale tests are useful to analyse the triggering factors separately. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: PDF, Image, CSV, TXT. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 83765202. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
